narrative:
Noble County has 7,828 registered voters, with 51.0% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 32.3% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 16.7%, a pronounced Republican lean of 15.5 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 31.7% of registrants.
